annotations.title: Which tokens pass my rule right now

description: The Robinhood Chain tokens that pass every filter of a member's rule right now, judged by PumpPill on its side. `rule` is the code (pp1....) the member copies from pumppill.org/customize. Each token comes with each filter's reading. A token passing is a match to the member's own rule, not a recommendation; compare with the last check to find NEW passes. Up to 40, biggest first.
name: rule_matches
